ReasoningScratchPad: Investigating storage access permissions and authentication issues
ClassificationReason: Authentication and authorization issue with storage access
Title: Storage Account Access Denied - 403 Errors
SystemDesignKnowledge: Azure Blob Storage with SAS token authentication
InitialSymptoms: Application unable to access storage blobs, 403 errors in logs
SymptomsObserved: 403 Forbidden errors when accessing blob storage, authentication failures, SAS token issues
StepsFollowed:
1. Verified SAS token expiration
2. Checked storage account permissions
3. Regenerated access keys
4. Updated application configuration
RootCause: Expired SAS token and incorrect RBAC permissions
Pitfalls: Always check token expiration before regenerating keys
